diagnosis_candidates.description: The file `application-dev.yml` contains the property `spring.config.activate.on-profile: staging`. In Spring Boot, this property overrides the file-name-based profile activation, meaning the configuration inside this file will only be applied when the `staging` profile is active. When the `dev` profile is active, the file is ignored, causing the application to fall back to the default `shipping.endpoint` defined in `application.yml`.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Remove the `spring.config.activate.on-profile: staging` property from `application-dev.yml` so that it correctly activates for the `dev` profile based on its file name, or rename the file to `application-staging.yml` if it was intended for the staging environment.
diagnosis_candidates.title: Incorrect profile activation condition in application-dev.yml

When the `dev` profile is active, this file is skipped, causing the application to fall back to the default endpoint defined in `application.yml`.
